jobs.title: Orchestrator: extract the per-item analyze-and-store pipeline (summarize, evaluate, build_llm_analysis, fetcher-metrics merge, kind classification, title_only-gated deep extraction, create_or_update_content, embedding) into one method fetch_source_content calls, with fetch_source_content's own behavior (stats, HIGH-priority notifications, INV-002 failure handling) and every existing orchestrator test unchanged

prismis-daemon refetch --type <youtube|rss|reddit> [--limit] [--dry-run]: select stored, non-archived, not-readable items of the requested type oldest-first; re-extract each through its own fetcher's single-item path (YouTube transcript extraction by stored video URL, article_extractor.extract_article for an RSS item's URL, Reddit's PRAW submission builder); route content that becomes readable back through job 1's analyze-and-store method in place, and patch title_only: true with no LLM call when it stays unreadable; obs_log an outcome event per refetched item; --dry-run reports the selection count and a median-real-cost estimate from the observability log without extracting, calling an LLM or writing, and a real run reports per-item outcome plus final counts and summed real cost
